preconditions.description: The number of towers in the bears' wall (n) and the elephant's wall (w) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The bears' wall heights list 'a' has exactly n elements, each between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == w and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b)
preconditions.description: The elephant's wall heights list 'b' has exactly w elements, each between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for i in range(n - w + 1) if all((a[i + j + 1] - a[i + j]) == (b[j + 1] - b[j]) for j in range(w - 1)) if w > 1 else n)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of starting positions i in the bears' wall where the sequence of height differences of a segment of length w matches the sequence of height differences of the elephant's wall. If w is 1, every position matches.
